learning_objective: 🎯 Unleash your wonderful imagination to mix different materials and invent your very own unique art masterpiece!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Artists are explorers! They look at everyday things like buttons, old newspapers, or dry leaves and imagine how they can become part of a beautiful artwork.
You don't have to just use crayons! Mixed media means combining things together, like pasting paper cutouts and then painting over them to make a fun collage.
In art, the sky can be green and trees can be purple. This chapter is all about using your imagination to invent things that don't even exist in the real world!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Trash to Treasure Collage!
fun_activity.instructions: Collect safe leftover things from your house like scrap paper, cotton balls, and a few dry leaves. Glue them on paper and use markers to turn them into a funny monster or a beautiful landscape!

quick_recap: ⭐ Exploring helps us find art materials in everyday objects around us.
⭐ Mixed media is when we use glue, paint, and real objects all on one paper.
⭐ There are no mistakes in art when you are using your imagination!
